answer: Down in the workshop the flour blender hangs her blended sacks on lines to settle, and the floor below is white with every grade of the year. Corn wheat grain grinder meal licence is the hanging: a licence wheat grain grinders carry after grinding loft audits. The comet is the first sack hung, the inlet the last before the lines are full, and the quartz is the filling, the lines heavy with flour. A cheat would hang 53 false sacks and fill 53 false lines.
